To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have discovered an anomalously high efficiency of the generation of the cross-poled radiation in a cubic nonlinearity medium at the intensities of the order of 1012 W/cm2.
we have demonstrated a new effect of the polarization rotation of femtosecond radiation in the BaF 2 crystal, the efficiency of which is comparable to that of other crystals with cubic symmetry.
the polarization of the femtoseconds laser radiation in the BaF _{2} crystal is rotated in the anomalous regime at the intensities above 2 × 10 ^{12} W cm ^{2}.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of the nonlinear optical phenomena occurring in the process of the interaction of the femtoseconds pulses with crystals.
the nonlinear polarization plane rotation in BaF2 crystal at the femtoseond laser radiation with 1.3 μm wavelength in a process of the ω = ω ω − ω generation on the χ(3) nonlinearity.
the study of the polarization plane rotations in the BaF _{2} crystal under the influence of the femtoseconds laser radiation with the wavelength of λ = 0.62 µm and the duration of τ = 200 fs.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the polarization rotation in the BaF _{2} crystal under intense femtoseond laser radiation is caused by the χ(3) process and the anomalous increase in polarization rotation is caused by the nonlinear rotation of polarization in the process of the cross-polarity generation.
the polarization rotation of intense femtoseconds laser radiation in Ba F2 is a complex nonlinear process.
the nonlinear polarization rotation of the femtoseconds laser radiation is a promising and efficient method for the generation of the cross-polyarized radiation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the nonlinear rotation of polarization in BaF2 is a very promising method for the generation of the cross-polyarized radiation with high efficiency.
the polarization rotation of the femtoseconds laser radiation in the cubic crystals is a promising method of the cross-polarity generation.

the rotation angle of the polarization of femtosecond pulses in a BaF2 crystal in the ω = 2ω - ω process on cubic nonlinearity χ ^{(3)} is proportional to the cube of the intensity at I < 2 × 10 ^{12} W/cm ^{2} and to the fifth power at I > 3 × 10 ^{11} W/cm ^{3}.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the efficiency of the polarization rotation is determined not only by the intensity of the laser radiation, but also by its pulse duration and spectral width.

the efficiency of the nonlinear polarization rotation in BaF2 crystal at the intensity of ∼3 ×1012 W cm-2 can be increased to 10% and the efficiency of the generation of the cross-pole component in the ω + ω - ω process can be increased to ∼10%.
the polarization rotation of the femtoseconds radiation can be controlled by the laser intensity.
